brief: Low one-storey flat-roofed post office of dark red brick in a fast-growing exurban town: a long plain front with three square picture windows, a slim metal coping, a small 'United States Post Office' sign by the glass entrance at one end, a tall flagpole, a bench and bike rack on the sidewalk, and an older gabled house next door.

facade.notes: the Isanti MN post office (c.1975): a long low flat-roofed dark-red-brick box with three square picture windows and a door at the end under a slim canopy; a flagpole, a bench, a newspaper box, on the sidewalk line next to an old frame building

why.note: the village post office: one small public room, a counter and a sorting room behind, a flag and a blue box
the 1960s-70s federal leased post office: a plain brick box built to a standard plan
